# Descent TCG

> Descent TCG is a collector-run trading card shop at 5205 33rd St E, Bradenton, FL 34203.
> It buys and sells rare and vintage trading cards — Pokémon, Disney Lorcana, Magic: The
> Gathering, and One Piece — including raw singles, professionally graded slabs, and sealed
> product (booster boxes, cases, Elite Trainer Boxes).
> Contact: matthew@descenttcg.com (typical response within 24–48 hours).
> Full retail inventory is hosted on the shop's TCGplayer Pro storefront: https://dig.tcgplayerpro.com/

## Key pages

- [Home](https://descenttcg.com/): Overview of the shop and how buying works.
- [Our Store](https://descenttcg.com/our-store): Descent Into Gaming in Bradenton: official logo, address, phone, seven-day hours, weekly play, trade-in rules, community links, online singles and in-store pickup guidance.
- [Lorcana Vault](https://descenttcg.com/lorcana-vault): Disney Lorcana chase cards and sealed product with prices; offers accepted on every item.
- [TCG Vault](https://descenttcg.com/sealed-vault): Sealed TCG product, including booster boxes, vintage packs, premium collections, regional exclusives, Magic: The Gathering TMNT product, and the Team Boss Pikachu (JP) collection.
- [About](https://descenttcg.com/about): The shop's story — collector-run since the late 1990s.
- [Contact](https://descenttcg.com/contact): Inquiries, valuations, and offers.

## Physical store: Descent Into Gaming

The physical store is at 5205 33rd St East, Bradenton, FL 34203. Call (941) 739-0220. Monday-Friday and Sunday hours are noon-9 pm; Saturday hours are 10 am-9 pm. Events may extend past regular hours.

The store's official website is https://descentintogaming.com/ . Its weekly lineup includes free play, One Piece, My Little Pony, Magic limited and Commander, Disney Lorcana, Pokémon, and Riftbound. See the Our Store page and Discord for current schedules. Published One Piece start times conflict; confirm in Discord. Date-specific events and entry details may change.

Trade-in policy: singles must be worth at least $5; no bulk accepted. Valuation uses multiple credible sources and percentages may change with market conditions. For online singles with in-store pickup, allow at least 24 hours and wait until the order is marked ready before collecting it.

Store community links: https://discord.gg/42cPv8E2fc ; https://www.instagram.com/digaming ; https://www.facebook.com/813817688766197 . Contact email remains matthew@descenttcg.com.
